mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Badger Ridge Middle School with the temperature at 35 degrees, but it feels like 25. We have a waxing crescent moon out, and overnight, expect the mercury to dip to 31 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is accepting public comment on several upcoming projects before the Plan Commission, including the proposed Sub-Zero expansion at Liberty Business Park. Additionally, municipal court services are available for those needing to handle traffic citations or ordinance violations.

We have plenty to do, including Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today and ART House 360 hosting Thursday night festivities. Looking ahead, you can catch Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard.
A noteworthy call from the police department occurred on October 25, when officers responded to a report of a vehicle stopped in an intersection, leading to an arrest for a first offence O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the rich and tasty Devil's Food Cake. The restaurant is currently open but will be closing its doors for the night in just under an hour, so plan your trip soon.
